_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A comment made while recording on the new page shares the recording's conversation. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". {{QUERY}} is the query string that opens the diff viewer on that commit in the repository. "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). "Wait for the clock to start" means: wait until the time element of the stop button no longer reads "00:00" (eval document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time")?.textContent !== "00:00", expect true). "Comment on the commit message" means: click the commit message's line (".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20"), fill ".diff-viewer-comment-input" with "Keep the old name.", and click the button named exactly "Add Comment". The server answers the recording's chat requests with 503 "unavailable" until call "accept chats". Call "drafts" counts the drafts the page made (POST /api/conversations/draft) and makes {{DRAFT_ID}} the first one's id; call "chats" returns the JSON list of the paths chat requests went to. To match the message input's (data-testid "message-input") value against a regular expression, eval the regex's test() on it, expecting true. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new?{{QUERY}} and wait for the commit message.
2. Click the start button; the stop button should become visible.
3. Comment on the commit message.
4. The comment lands in the composer, which saves it as the page's draft: the message input's value should match /Keep the old name\.\n*$/. Call "drafts" should return exactly "1". The page's URL should then end with exactly "/c/{{DRAFT_ID}}" (eval location.href.endsWith("/c/{{DRAFT_ID}}"), expect true).
5. Wait for the clock to start, then click the stop button. data-testid "review-recording-error" should contain "unavailable".
6. Call "accept chats", then click data-testid "review-recording-send". It is sent.
7. Both attempts went to the page's draft, and no other was made: call "chats" should return exactly ["/api/conversation/{{DRAFT_ID}}/chat","/api/conversation/{{DRAFT_ID}}/chat"], and call "drafts" still exactly "1".
8. ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='{{DRAFT_ID}}']" should have class "active" (eval classList.contains("active"), expect true), and the message input's value should still match /Keep the old name\.\n*$/.
